name: Macon County, AL
findings: Macon County has 97 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Macon County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Macon County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
